messages:
Nora (Finance): FYI BillingBot flagged an overnight surge: ~$8,750 of untagged GPU spend in europe-west1 at ~02:00 UTC. Need quick triage - could be partner-facing.
BillingBot: ALERT: 2026-04-05 02:07 UTC - UNATTRIBUTED_GPU - $8,750 - 12 GPUs - projects detected: 5 - details: /billing/alerts/1142
Sam (Platform): I'm looking. Initial thought: new CI runners from the release pipeline used the wrong service account and landed in 'shared-ci-prod' project without labels.
Rachna (ML Eng): We ran a hyperparam sweep for "dialog-rerank" around that time from my account. I intentionally used shared runners to save time, but I added a label on the job. Checking if labels propagated.
Wei (SRE): Noted we rolled out runner-image v3.2.1 yesterday; I saw a label propagation regression in the image that strips custom metadata. Opening a quick-invest PR.
Sam (Platform): Running query to map costs by job id and ip:
```
SELECT job_name, project_id, SUM(gpu_hours) as hours, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM billing.gpu_usage
WHERE date = '2026-04-05' AND label_cost_center IS NULL
GROUP BY job_name, project_id
ORDER BY cost DESC;
```
Sam (Platform): Results: top hits -> shared-ci-prod (4.9k), dialog-rerank-sweep (2.1k), partner-beta-poc (1.2k). That sums to ~8.2k, small remainder in infra housekeeping.
Nora (Finance): partner-beta-poc is customer-facing. If partner usage, we need to correct and invoice/credit accordingly.
Omar (VP Finance): Approve provisional credit to partner-beta up to $6,500 pending confirmation. For internal ~2.25k, move to research buffer. Document all changes.
Rachna (ML Eng): Confirmed dialog-rerank jobs (job ids: 48512-48530) were launched by my team and incorrectly routed through shared CI due to ephemeral token expiry. I'll file a postmortem and cover internal share.
CostOpsBot: Suggested remediation: run tag-backfill /jobs/tag-sweep --date 2026-04-05 && generate report to /ops/reports/orphan-sweep-20260405.csv
Sam (Platform): Kicked off backfill. ETA 30m. Also propose automating a nightly orphan sweep and an earlier alert threshold: escalate when untagged GPU > $4k in a region or > $2k for partner projects.
Nora (Finance): Agree on thresholds. Also request retro billing workflow: 1) generate invoice delta via billing export 2) send partner credit memo 3) log adjustment in FIN-1310.
Wei (SRE): PR for runner-image revert and label fix in flight. Will also add admission control to reject runners without required labels for GPU scopes.
Sam (Platform): Backfill finished. Backfill diff: assigned $6,100 to partner-beta-poc (matches project tags), $1,900 to dialog-rerank team, $750 to infra housekeeping. Pushing CSV to FIN-1310.
BillingBot: Created ticket FIN-1310 and attached backfill report /billing/exports/2026-04-05-orphan.csv
Nora (Finance): Opening FIN-1310 to track invoice delta and partner communication. Omar approved provisional credit; I'll draft the credit memo and loop in legal for partner notice.
Omar (VP Finance): Keep me in the loop on the partner communication copy. Also want a weekly jitter report for GPU orphaning until we have the runner-image fix fully rolled back.
Rachna (ML Eng): Action items: I'll: 1) confirm job ids in FIN-1310, 2) shift remaining experiment charges to team budget.
Wei (SRE): Action: PR for label fix + admission control, and run a 7-day orphan sweep to validate.
Sam (Platform): Action: add nightly orphan-sweep job, implement the alert threshold changes in CostOps, and add an automated invoice-delta script to populate FIN tickets.
Nora (Finance): Thanks all 44d Recap: FIN-1310 tracks partner credit and internal reallocations, thresholds updated (> $4k region / $2k partner), backfill done, runner-image fix PR, nightly sweep scheduled. I'll update FIN-1310 with draft credit memo later today.
